name: VPS database runtime
assumption: Primary database is hosted on the user's VPS.
hard_rules: Do not expose MySQL port 3306 to the public internet unless protected by VPN/firewall allowlist.
Run migrations from the backend host or SSH session, not from browser clients.
Production must not silently fall back to static JSON when DATABASE_URL is configured but unreachable.
Daily logical backup is mandatory before full-corpus import jobs.
